description: Create a contact. Give at least one of first_name, last_name, display_name or company. record_type_name (a contact workflow, e.g. Customer) and status_name (a status in that workflow, e.g. Lead) are required and must match the account settings (jobnimbus_get_account_settings). Workflow automations may fire. JobNimbus: POST /contacts.

actor.description: Optional JobNimbus user email to act as. The record is created/edited with that user's permissions and shows them as the author. Needs an admin-level API key.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields by their JobNimbus name, e.g. {"Claim Number":"124523-f","Date of Loss":1550692800} or {"cf_string_1":"…"}. Dates are unix seconds. is_active / is_archived are ignored.

description.description: Description / notes on the contact record.

sales_rep.description: jnid of the user who is the sales rep.

source_name.description: Lead source name, e.g. Referral — must be one of the account's lead sources.

status_name.description: Status within that workflow, e.g. Lead.

name: jobnimbus_create_contact
title: Create a contact
